description: FULL mode baselines — engine state expectations when quant fixture suites are executed with all engines active (Butterfly, Entropy, VRF, Heartbeat, Paradox). LMSR outputs are identical to LMSR-only mode; engines add tracking, fairness, and integrity on top.

quant_market_hygiene_v0_1.full_mode_notes: LMSR costs identical. Each valid trade produces one TRADE Wing Flap. High-impact trades (small b) hit impact clamp at ±0.05.

b_sensitivity_suite_v0_1.full_mode_notes: LMSR costs identical. Impact magnitude varies with b: small b → larger raw impact (often clamped), large b → smaller raw impact.

api_fidelity_suite_v0_1.full_mode_notes: Quote correctness and state feed completeness verified. Engine state (stability, logic_gap) fields now populated by real engine outputs rather than fixture stubs.

perturbation_suite_v0_1.full_mode_notes: VRF seeds from fixtures produce deterministic outputs. Saboteur pressure and paradox trigger cases exercised with real engine stack.
